summary: Declare the minimal source set for an API-first validated structured-output operation while preserving SSE /turns.
final_report: Implemented API-first structured outputs while preserving the existing SSE /turns path. Added POST /api/sessions/{session_id}/outputs for chat, mermaid, todo, and quiz artifacts; strict extra-forbid Pydantic draft/content/envelope models with a FastAPI-compatible discriminated response union; exact single-value JSON parsing with BOM/fence normalization, trailing-data rejection, one bounded repair attempt, strict scalar validation, quiz count/index/duplicate-option checks, and server-owned IDs/positions/validation metadata. Added Mermaid validation through a pinned Node adapter calling mermaid.parse, with source length/directive checks and fail-closed model_output errors when the dependency or adapter is unavailable. Added focused fake-LLM/API/Mermaid contract tests. Reconciled the expected shared-worktree app/main.py and README.md changes by preserving static UI serving and documenting the new router/modules. Updated run.sh/run.bat to provision npm dependencies when npm is available. Verification: focused structured/API/Mermaid tests 11 passed; SSE regression plus structured/API/Mermaid tests 25 passed; compileall and node --check passed; FastAPI OpenAPI exposed the expected oneOf discriminator for kind; TypeAdapter response validation passed. Mermaid live adapter smoke remains unavailable because the prior npm timeout left an incomplete node_modules tree; the API fails closed as designed. No commit made.
notes: Implementation finalized in the declared source set. Shared-worktree changes in app/main.py and README.md were inspected and preserved.
